title: Label JSON number overflow in the viewer
changes: Show browser numeric overflow as a labeled out-of-range value instead of misleadingly displaying JSON null, and explain that parsed numbers can lose precision.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-json-table-synthetic-zqkmnmv6 checked positive and negative overflow, safe and unsafe integers and existing navigation in both viewer modes.

Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-json-table-local-fkxzxk_r checked all nine pages with unchanged embedded data. Docker unit rom-data-viewer-json-table-docker-_wvjna3r matched Python on synthetic input.
limitations: JavaScript can also round finite decimal numbers or underflow them; the raw file remains authoritative. The original dataset volume was unavailable and native Windows was not tested.
